verdict: No strategy cleared a 95% bootstrap CI entirely above 0 after commission on this sample.
SPRT did not call EDGE on any primary strategy at H0=-5% vs H1=+5%.
Kash does NOT beat market on winner log-loss (1.85477 vs 1.78912).
Benter blend does not beat market log-loss (1.78949 vs 1.78739).
Local form log-loss 1.75462 vs market 1.75808 on 2783 RA races (SP priced).
Fav scheduled-off vs BSP: mean CLV=-0.005, soff>BSP on 44.69% of favs (n=115340).
Back fav at soff @5% comm: ROI=-2.667% CI=[-3.49, -1.834].
Top5 tip Rank-1 @ BSP after 5% commission: ROI=-3.899% CI=[-5.244, -2.582] (n=126652). Unbiased; SPRT=no_edge.

Earlier Top5 ROI of ~+26% was INVALID: filtering to markets with win_sum==1 dropped races where the winner was outside the published top-5, which deleted Rank-1 losses. Unbiased Rank-1 @ BSP after 5% commission is about -3.9%.
caveats: Multiple strategies tested → winner's curse; pre-register one before claiming live edge.
BSP fill is an idealisation; live matching/slippage/limits differ.
Commission assumed flat 5% or 8% on net winnings; real Betfair tiers/boosts vary.
Kash RP is Betfair's own published model — any edge vs BSP is public and may be competed away.
history.key_finding: Betfair BSP on ANZ AU 2020-2026 is near-perfectly calibrated across probability bins; the favourite-longshot bias seen on TAB SP in proto_results is largely washed out by BSP. Only the extreme short-priced bin (p>0.7) runs hot (z=+2.6).

ukire.verdict: UK/IRE: nothing cleared a 95% range above zero after commission (best: GB_back_fav_bsp_c00 ROI 0.95%).
